A '''river serpent''' was a carnivorous predator native to the [[Kinkosa rain forest|rain forests]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kirtania]]. They were between two to three [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, and basked on river banks waiting for larger prey such as [[Rodent/Legends|rodents]] or wild [[Swine|pigs]]. The serpents preferred to attack by luring their prey into rivers where they had the advantage, then constricted around them and bit them. They could kill prey up to the size of a [[Human/Legends|Human]].
